description: MainActivity.java for an Android app demonstrating commit content support via InputConnection. It creates multiple EditText views with different MIME type configurations, handles content commit events, and displays related info in a WebView and TextViews.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates handling of rich content input via InputConnection, supporting multiple MIME types, and displaying content details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and restores previous input content info if available.

methods.name: onCommitContent
methods.description: Handles commit of input content, checks MIME type support, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCommitContentInternal
methods.description: Processes the committed content, requests permission if needed, and updates display elements.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current input content info and flags for activity state restoration.

methods.name: createEditTextWithContentMimeTypes
methods.description: Creates an EditText configured with specific MIME types for testing input method behavior.

methods.name: flagsToString
methods.description: Converts flags used in commitContent to a human-readable string.
